description: Archive an image asset to soft-hide it from active media pickers without deleting binary files from storage. Call to declutter media library when an image is retired from active use. For permanent deletion, use delete_image instead. Idempotent state transition, fully reversible via restore_image. Slides and carousels currently referencing this image continue to display and render without disruption. Returns updated Image record with status set to archived.

imageId.description: The unique image asset identifier to archive.

name: archive_image
title: Archive image
